subject: Heads-up: L4 native SpringBoard candidate build soon — production FREEZE window
body: After lowering posts LEASE RELEASE L2 with the final compiler, root will post 'FREEZE L4 <commit>' and commit a coherent snapshot. From that post until 'UNFREEZE', do NOT write any production file under gpu/metal (edit private copies/patches only). Host tests and corpus work may continue (no rustc/ninja). Native build reads the working tree directly, so this is mandatory.
